blockingIssues.problem: The blanket claim that the source does not establish the broader portfolio’s implementation status overlooks its explicit status: the portfolio remains under development. This could erase the boundary that the selected Idea relies on; what remains unspecified is the implementation status of individual broader products and their demonstrated effectiveness.
blockingIssues.sourceQuote: the broader portfolio and operating model remain under development.
blockingIssues.constraint: Preserve the source-stated status of the broader portfolio as under development; limit uncertainty to details the source does not establish, such as individual products’ implementation status or demonstrated effectiveness.
